findingClass: Any documents row whose extraction_status is FAILED with an extraction_error naming the #862 E-1 guard ('may not be written from the document path') — before #1016, one exchange-owned field (basisOfAllotmentDate / initiationOfRefundsDate / creditOfSharesDate) in an otherwise-clean extraction threw AFTER the ipos upsert had already run, failing the whole document and losing every other field's receipts.
failThreshold: Any documents row where extraction_error ILIKE '%may not be written from the document path%' (source=DRHP). Reported per IPO by company name, slug and document type, never as a bare count (signal-ownership.md R1). Measured on ipodhan_staging 2026-09-25 (read-only, via the sanctioned tunnel): 1 row — Runwal Enterprises Ltd. (runwal-enterprises-ltd, status OPEN), a PRICE_BAND_AD document uploaded 2026-09-24T14:46:19Z, extraction_status FAILED, extraction_error citing creditOfSharesDate.
unverifiableWhen: The tunnel to ipodhan_staging is unreachable, or the documents.extraction_error column has been truncated/rotated past the row's original message.
note: e1_document_path_extraction_failed: SPEC ONLY - not yet implemented as a record() call in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs, so it stays in notCoveredByThisManifest (counting it in 'checks' would read as wider coverage than the floor actually has, per scripts/tests/audit-detection-floor.test.mjs case 79). The #1016 fix (scraper/src/services/filing-persister.ts) stops this class going forward — a document that prints an E-1 field now has that field filtered before the write, logged as a structured 'e1-document-path-refused' warning, and completes instead of failing — so no NEW row should join this population after the fix ships. This entry exists to (a) name the ONE pre-existing row so it is not silently forgotten (readmission is an owner/supervisor decision, not made here — no write was made to it), and (b) give the nightly audit a concrete query to promote into 'checks' the next time this file is touched.
owner: UNASSIGNED - owed to #1016. Promotion out of notCoveredByThisManifest requires a record('e1_document_path_extraction_failed') call in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs and one run against ipodhan_staging confirming the count stays 0 for new documents after the fix.
